graph.mission: Discover and validate cumulative operational inheritance: mechanisms, fragments, parameterization, semantic resolution, freshness and novelty boundaries.

physics.mission: Search falsification-first for Web-dynamical structure beyond memory/similarity using operational definitions, strong nulls and identifiability.

runtime.mission: Build and falsify measurement/execution substrates: raw observation, writable controls, auth/session/network/side-effect validity and runtime reliability.

product.mission: Turn audited capabilities into a coherent external-agent product and continuously test product economics without freezing research architecture.

intel.mission: Find, reproduce and stress-test datasets, baselines and prior art only when they can alter a live SPIDER claim or experimental design.

frontier.mission: Search outside the current solution basin for high-upside falsifiable mechanisms that could radically reduce agent exploration or change SPIDER's architecture.
